capture_config_suggestion.label: agent technical default (D-018), provisional until the first measured run
capture_config_suggestion.qualification_run_requirement: This suggestion disables E07 inputs and per-step E03 evidence. An E03/E07 qualification run must set parameter_snapshots: init_and_each_step and parameter_hashing: sha256_local, with max_event_bytes sized for the full tensor table measured on the host; the choice per run is recorded in the run registration (review F5).
capture_config_suggestion.basis: simulator replies carry metric arrays only (runtime.proto SimulationReturn); completion artifacts carry raw frames and may reach hundreds of MB per episode (INFERRED, unmeasured); full tensor hashing of a 10B model per step is L3 and costly, so E03 hashing is chosen per qualification run; max_checkpoint_file_bytes (64 GiB) bounds each exported safetensors file hashed after _save_checkpoint (E02/E21) above the expected few-GB shards (INFERRED, unmeasured); hashing time per export is L3
